title: Canonical tensor inclusions are natural and compatible with scalar extension
statement:
theorem tensorInclusion_coherent :
    (∀ (E : Index l Ω) {K K' P P' : Stage l Ω X E} (f : K ⟶ K') (g : P ⟶ P'),
      (inclusion E).map
          ((RationalVerdier.tensor D l hl X (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E)).map (Prod.mkHom f g)) ≫
          (tensorInclusion D l hl Ω X E K' P').hom =
        (tensorInclusion D l hl Ω X E K P).hom ≫
          (CoefQbarTensor D l hl Ω X).map
            (Prod.mkHom ((inclusion E).map f) ((inclusion E).map g))) ∧
    (∀ {E L : Index l Ω} (h : E ≤ L) (K P : Stage l Ω X E),
      let := RationalVerdier.units D l hl X
      (inclusion L).map ((rationalTensorStageComparison l Ω X h).hom.app (K, P)) ≫
          (tensorInclusion D l hl Ω X L
            (((stageSystem l Ω X).T h).obj K) (((stageSystem l Ω X).T h).obj P)).hom ≫
          (CoefQbarTensor D l hl Ω X).map
            (Prod.mkHom (((stageSystem l Ω X).transIso h).hom.app K)
              (((stageSystem l Ω X).transIso h).hom.app P)) =
        ((stageSystem l Ω X).transIso h).hom.app
            ((RationalVerdier.tensor D l hl X (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E)).obj (K, P)) ≫
          (tensorInclusion D l hl Ω X E K P).hom)

proof.text: For the coherent rational tensor family, use tensor_descent_spec and uniqueness of bilinear descent to identify the prescribed common-stage tensor with explicit descent.

The diagonal from the synchronized product stage system is fully faithful. Apply its inverse pairing functor and the tensor-family morphism to isoToStage. The resulting isomorphism is tensorInclusion by the normalized tensor comparison formula and the chosen functor object prescription.

Functoriality of this construction gives naturality on finite morphisms. Compose isoToStage with a further stage transition; cancellation of the pairing isomorphisms gives exactly the scalar transition square, including repeated fields.
